io.slote.name: Slote
io.slote.subtitle: Draw and type on the same page
io.slote.localizedDescription: Slote puts handwriting and typing on the same page. Write on PDFs and EPUB books, highlight, sketch with seven pens and pressure, and sync across Android, Windows, iPhone and iPad, encrypted on your device. No account needed. Free during launch. https://slote-website.vercel.app
